evidence: The surface morphology and rms roughness were evaluated using scanning electron microscopy (SEM, S-4700, Hitachi) and atomic force microscopy (AFM, DI-3100, Veeco), respectively. The crystallographic structures of Ru and RuO2 were examined by glancing angle X-ray diffraction (GAXRD, SmartLab, Rigaku). The chemical binding states of the deposited films were examined using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, K-Alpha, Thermo Scientific). The resistivity was determined by measuring the sheet resistance using a 4-point probe (CMT-SR1000N, AIT). The Ru, C, O, and H profiles in the Ru films grown at the different temperatures were examined by time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (TOFSIMS, IMS 7f, Cameca). In situ QMS Analysis of the Ru and RuO2 ALD Processes. The surface reaction chemistry for Ru/RuO2 ALD was investigated using QMS (ABB Extrel MEXM-1000, BALZERS) by in situ sampling of the byproduct gases produced during the deposition processes.
